messages:
Maya: Ok team — final push for next week's CloudCraft pop-up. Need to lock booth layout, swag list, speaking logistics, and lead routing by EOD.

Derek: Booth layout proposal: table against back wall (Table B4), standing demo kiosk, 2 stools. AV: 1 monitor (HDMI) + mic for presenter. I'll confirm power drops. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Swag counts: eco notebooks x250, sticker packs x500, branded socks x100 (optional). Vendor PO# 4421-RED; ETA to SF warehouse 3 days pre-event. I can trim socks if budget bites.

Liam: Shipping plan: two pallets — props/monitor and swag. ETA window: arrive 48h before exhibitor move-in. Placeholder UPS ref: 1Z999AA10123456784. Will update with real tracking after pickup.

Jamal: Speaking update: talk accepted in Track B at 14:30. Format: 10-min talk + 5 Qs. Final deck due Mon 23:59. Who's presenting?

Maya: I'll take the stage. Need one slide on benchmark narrative (latency vs cost) and one on rollout/rollback policy. Demo will show latency dashboard.

Priya: I'll draft the two slides + a short program blurb. Ordering 50 printed benchmark one-pagers for handout. Also making a small postcard with two headline variants for A/B test.

Derek: AV checklist: test HDMI dongle on company laptop images. Pack adapter kit: USB-C->HDMI, DisplayPort->HDMI, HDMI->VGA fallback. OpsBot will ping venue for cable inventory.

OpsBot: reminder: exhibitor badge pickup Tue 08:30 PST. Parking codes emailed to list.

Liam: Demo ops: prepared VM image with offline dataset + restricted demo API key at s3://redwood-assets/expo/demos/redwood-demo-v1.img. Access via creds in 1Password. We'll run local server so we can demo without internet.

Maya: Consent line for interactive demos approved by Legal: "By using this demo you agree we may retain anonymized log data for product improvement." Add to lead capture form.

Jamal: Stage logistics: will request clicker + stage mic. Presenter to arrive 15 min early for sound check. Also bring timeline slide to sync with MC.

Priya: Swag packing list draft:
- 1x eco notebook + 2 stickers + 1 postcard (benchmark one-pager)
- 1x sticker-only backup pack for walk-bys
Packing volunteers will assemble 250 gift sets.

Maya: Also print 20 developer trial cards with promo codes (3 months hosted credits). QR points to landing page with ?src=cloudcraft2026.

Liam: Lead capture flow: QR -> Google Form -> Zapier -> HubSpot. Mapping:
Form fields: name,email,company,product_interest,interest_level,wants_webinar,notes
Zap: New Response -> Create/Update Contact (HS) -> Create Deal -> Tag: "cloudcraft2026"
We should test with 10 fake leads pre-event.

Derek: Floor staffing: 4 ppl per shift. Shifts: 09:30-12:30, 12:30-15:30, 15:30-18:00. Need 2 extra people for setup/breakdown.

Priya: I'll take middle shift to manage swag restock. Liam + Jamal on morning setup. Maya + Derek on afternoon.

Jamal: Suggest live demo schedule board: 10:30, 11:15, 12:00, 13:00, 14:30 (post-talk), 16:00. Sign: "Live demo every 45 min".

Maya: A/B test on postcard headlines: "Predictable LLM inference at scale" vs "Lower inference cost, consistent latency". Add 1-question poll to lead form to record which line resonated.

Liam: Tagging in HubSpot: product_interest values: dedicated, hosted, private. Zapier to populate HS property product_interest. Also adding property wants_webinar (yes/no).

Priya: Created Slack channel #cloudcraft-live for in-event status updates. Please post quick 1-line notes (sales hot lead, press visit, demo glitch).

Derek: Contingency: if monitor fails, demo via laptop + handheld mic. Bring HDMI->VGA adapter and 10 printed one-pagers for press.

Maya: Press/analyst outreach: I have 6 contacts; scheduling quick 1:1s 15:00-16:30. Priya will send follow-up with benchmark assets.

Jamal: Post-event follow-up: invite all leads to a deeper webinar. Capture wants_webinar in form. Also add an option to schedule a sales meeting.

Priya: I'll add the wants_webinar field and a "Schedule follow-up" CTA. Drafting day+1 email template for leads.

Liam: I'll upload booth insurance to event portal tonight and create an Ops checklist in Drive. Sharing link in #cloudcraft-live once done.

OpsBot: deployed checklist doc: https://drive.company/repo/cloudcraft-ops-checklist

Maya: If we can close swag packing and the Zap mapping by EOD today, we'll be set. Thanks team :raised_hands:
